name: perubahan_ekuitas_psak118
query:
WITH b AS (
  -- mutasi periode (filter mulai.$gte & date.$lte) dan saldo s/d tanggal akhir (hanya date.$lte)
  SELECT G1.part, G1.account_id, G1.dk
  FROM (
    SELECT 'mut'::text AS part, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.tanggal::date AS dm, jv.account_id, jv.department_id, jv.project_id, jv.cost_code_id,
           COALESCE(jv.debit,0)::numeric - COALESCE(jv.kredit,0)::numeric AS dk
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id JOIN kiraan k0 ON k0.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'akhir'::text AS part, g.tanggal::date AS d, DATE '9999-12-31' AS dm, jv.account_id, jv.department_id, jv.project_id, jv.cost_code_id,
           COALESCE(jv.debit,0)::numeric - COALESCE(jv.kredit,0)::numeric AS dk
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id JOIN kiraan k0 ON k0.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
akun AS (
  SELECT k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama, kl.noklasifikasi AS kls,
         COALESCE(sk.namasubklasifikasi, '(Tanpa subklasifikasi)') AS komponen, COALESCE(sk.nosubklasifikasi, 0) AS komponen_urut,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.part = 'akhir' THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS akhir,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.part = 'mut' AND b.dk < 0 THEN -b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS tambah,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.part = 'mut' AND b.dk > 0 THEN b.dk ELSE 0 END) AS kurang
  FROM kiraan  k                                   -- semua akun ekuitas ikut, termasuk saldo 0 (disaring di tampilan)
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.account_id = k.id
  WHERE kl.noklasifikasi >= 3
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT komponen_urut, komponen, akun_kode, akun_nama,
         (akhir - tambah + kurang)::numeric(18,2) AS saldo_awal, 0::numeric(18,2) AS laba_periode,
         tambah::numeric(18,2) AS penambahan, kurang::numeric(18,2) AS pengurangan, akhir::numeric(18,2) AS saldo_akhir
  FROM akun WHERE kls = 3
  UNION ALL
  -- saldo laba: akumulasi laba rugi (penutupan buku Zahir tidak berupa jurnal)
  SELECT 999999999, 'Saldo laba', '', 'Saldo laba',
         (SUM(akhir) - SUM(tambah) + SUM(kurang))::numeric(18,2), (SUM(tambah) - SUM(kurang))::numeric(18,2), 0, 0, SUM(akhir)::numeric(18,2)
  FROM akun WHERE kls >= 4
)
SELECT * FROM hasil
ORDER BY komponen_urut, komponen, akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
